channel.description: Latest articles from Detroit Sports Nation (detroitsportsnation.com)

item.title: Detroit Lions Miss Out On Potential Starting Center
item.description: The Detroit Lions may have missed out on a potential center option after Tyler Biadasz agreed to a three-year, $30 million deal with the Los Angeles Chargers.

item.title: Report: Detroit Tigers Have Not Made an Offer to Tarik Skubal
item.description: Detroit Tigers ace Tarik Skubal says the team has not made a long-term contract offer despite his upcoming free agency after the 2026 season.

item.title: Detroit Lions Trade Up, Land Replacement for David Montgomery in 2026 Mock Draft
item.description: In a new 2026 NFL mock draft from The Athletic, the Detroit Lions trade up in the fourth round to select Penn State running back Kaytron Allen as a potential replacement for David Montgomery.

item.title: Detroit Tigers Announce 5 Roster Moves in Advance of Justin Verlander Spring Debut
item.description: The Detroit Tigers optioned Jake Miller and Drew Sommers to Triple-A Toledo while reassigning three players to minor league camp as spring training roster cuts continue.

item.title: Taylor Decker Requests Release from Detroit Lions
item.description: Detroit Lions veteran left tackle Taylor Decker announced on Instagram that he has requested his release after 10 seasons with the franchise.

item.title: Report Reveals Why Taylor Decker Has Requested Release from Detroit Lions
item.description: A new report from the Detroit Free Press reveals that Taylor Decker requested his release after the Lions asked him to take a pay cut.

item.title: Detroit Red Wings Trade Elmer Söderblom to Penguins
item.description: The Detroit Red Wings traded forward Elmer Söderblom to the Pittsburgh Penguins for San Jose’s 2026 third-round pick just hours before the NHL trade deadline.

item.title: Dylan Larkin Injured in Red Wings Loss to Panthers
item.description: Detroit Red Wings captain Dylan Larkin left Thursday’s game against the Florida Panthers with a painful injury.
